name: LastAgentRouting_Template
description:
This Flow checks if someone called in the last 24 hours and routes the call to the same person. 
It is a Last Agent Routing example flow.
Uses HTTP into WebexCCAPIs to the Search API, using GraphQL.

promptsTts.value: Hello, welcome to the last agent routing demo. We will lookup your info and route you to the last agent you spoke to.
